Name: Rajkumar S. Pant
Bio: Prof Rajkumar S. Pant is a distinguished faculty member in the Department of Aerospace Engineering at IIT Bombay, with over 34 years of teaching experience. He holds a PhD from Cranfield University, UK, and has held visiting professorships at Virginia Tech, Nanyang Technological University, and Plaksha University.
Education: PhD, Design, Structures & Systems, Cranfield University | MTech, Aeronautical Engineering, IIT Madras | BSc (Engg), Aeronautical Engineering, PEC Chandigarh
Research_Summary:
Prof Pant's research focuses on aerospace engineering, with particular emphasis on lighter-than-air systems, aircraft design, air transportation, and optimization.

Areas of work:

Lighter-than-Air systems

Aircraft Design

Air Transportation

Optimization
Publications_Sample: Prof Pant has published 284 papers in aerospace engineering.
